column1: # Test cases for ambashador, one per line, in the form:
# hook should fall through to the interactive prompt) or 'explain' (fall through
# and additionally return a 'context' string advising the model). Blank lines and
# lines beginning with '#' are ignored. Leading and trailing whitespace in the
# command is significant and preserved, so cases can cover odd spacing.
# Commands that are simply not on the allowlist.
# 'find' is allowed for search, but execution and deletion flags are denied.
# 'git' is allowed only for read-only subcommands, named immediately after it.
# Pipelines: the first stage uses the full allowlist, later stages the narrower
# 'tee' is a deliberate file-writing exception, allowed in either position.
# 'sed' must be explicitly sandboxed wherever it appears. An un-sandboxed sed is
# rejected with advice rather than a bare fall-through.
# File descriptor duplication is permitted, but only in the '<digit>>&<digit>'
# form and only where it cannot mask a real redirect or a backgrounding '&'.
# Discarding stderr is permitted, but only as a trailing '<digit>>/dev/null'
# with an exact path, and never as a way to launder a rejected command.
# Redirects, substitution, escapes and backgrounding are always rejected.
# Empty and whitespace-only commands are never auto-approved.
# Newlines separate commands, so each line must be validated on its own. '\n'
# in a command below is an escape for a real newline.
